name: vc-deal-flow-signal
description: GitHub momentum tracking for venture deal flow. Find startups whose engineering is accelerating before they raise. 12 read-only tools (1 metered) across 15 sectors of venture-backed startups, refreshed weekly.

tools.name: get_trending_startups
tools.description: Top 20 startups by engineering acceleration across all 15 sectors for the current weekly period.

tools.name: search_startups_by_sector
tools.description: Every tracked startup within a sector, ranked by engineering acceleration.

tools.name: get_startup_signal
tools.description: Full engineering-acceleration profile for a single startup, by display name or GitHub org slug.

tools.name: get_signals_summary
tools.description: Period, sector and startup counts, last refresh, citation, and direct URLs to machine-readable formats.

tools.name: get_diligence_dossier
tools.description: Public-source diligence dossier for a company or entity: M&A history, public backers, and the published engineering signal. Returns found:false with an honest note when outside the tracked corpus, never guesses.

tools.name: get_scout_receipts
tools.description: Compute a Scout Score (0-100) for a GitHub user from their starring history vs validated unicorns.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Full methodology document covering data sources, signal classification, refresh cadence, and known limitations.

tools.name: get_deep_signal
tools.description: PAID per-request (€0.19/call via pre-paid credits or x402 USDC on Base; misses are FREE). Returns enriched signal: composite score, sector percentile, plain-English thesis, comparables, and multi-period history.

tools.name: share_result
tools.description: Compose a ready-to-share social post (Twitter/Bluesky/Mastodon/LinkedIn/Telegram) about a prior tool result, with per-platform char counts and intent URLs. Composes only, never posts on the user's behalf (two-step approval).

tools.name: predict_funding
tools.description: Transparent, scored funding-likelihood claim for one tracked startup, with the full evidence chain, confidence level, honest caveats, and citable provenance (methodology + SSRN).

tools.name: shortlist_signals
tools.description: Build and score a shortlist of N startups against a thesis, with optional sector and geography filters.

tools.name: compare_signals
tools.description: Compare engineering-acceleration signals across multiple startups side by side.

academic.citation: VC Deal Flow Signal (signals.gitdealflow.com), Q2 2026 data.
